lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p2 - Talk about the pictures.

details: Talk about the pictures allows students to recognise familiar objects linked to alphabet letters and initial letter sounds, supporting word–image connection.
Look for accurate naming of objects, correct linking of letters to pictures, clear pronunciation, and students referring to the pictures when speaking.

Heads Up:

Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.

Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs
